title: Your best friend. One minute.
idea: There's a catch, episode 7: Spud's best friend is trapped in a burning block; he can rewind time and only he remembers, but every rewind the fire starts earlier; on the last one he pulls the alarm before any fire shows and everyone thinks he is crazy

Chip at his open window, the smoke coming down over it
the watch: his thumb clicks the crown, the hands spin backward
the fire runs backward into the window; grey world, Spud in colour
the same block, no fire: Chip leans out with a mug and waves; Spud stares up
loop 2: he sprints in through the front door, past the red alarm box
the stairs burst into flame under the lobby clock, earlier than last time
his eyes go from the flames up to the clock; he clicks the watch
loop 3: smoke already rolls over the lobby floor; he runs up the stairs
the hallway, smoke along the floor: Spud bangs on a door with both gloves
the grumpy neighbour in curlers waves him off: Go home, kid.
the fire rolls down the stairs; he falls; the watch cracks on the tiles
the low: the whole block ablaze, Spud small on his knees, Chip's shape in his window
his eyes land on the red alarm box beside the door
the last loop: he lands and pulls the alarm before any fire shows; the bell rings
everyone out before any fire: furious neighbours, the curler neighbour points at Spud, Chip last with his mug
the frame-0 camera again, the block dark and whole: Chip alive beside him: You're crazy.
